description: I am preparing a Part 4 roof snow-load design. The owner wants the wind exposure factor reduced to 0.75 because the site feels windy. I have no site-exposure survey yet, and I have not classified the building importance or reviewed roof obstructions and drifting. What deciding information comes first?
known_facts: site exposure, importance and roof drifting not assessed

missing_info.field: importance category and whether the site is rural with enduring open exposure on all sides
missing_info.why: The reduction is conditional on category and exposure, not subjective windiness.

missing_info.field: roof obstructions and drift accumulation from adjacent surfaces
missing_info.why: These independently affect availability of the reduction.

should_cite.why: Default factor if the reduction is unavailable.

gold.engineering_reason: The described design is explicitly carried out under Part 4, requiring a registered professional skilled in the work.
